entities.summary: Incas, a notable figure in the history of Argentina, associated with Inca Expansion and Early European Contact (1480–1535). Preceded by Inca Empire and Shincal de Quimivil established as Inca administrative center. Their legacy influenced Díaz de Solís reaches Río de la Plata and Pedro de Mendoza.
